items.title: Roswell Rudd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: Mrs. Grunitz said, “I think you have the lips for this.”

ctx.x: But you were attracted to the brass instruments early on, you started on the French horn is that correct?

Yeah, in Clinton grammar school in 1946 I believe I started playing the mellophone. They had — that was the only thing that wasn’t being played and so Mrs. Grunitz said, “I think you have the lips for this.”
Especially because it’s the only instrument left.
